title: Customer support doesn’t seem to exist
body: I would give 5 stars, because I’ve been using the app for a while now and there’s not much I could suggest to improve it. Unfortunately, I needed to contact customer support and I realised there is no such thing, no way of contacting anyone responsible for the app. It’s a shame.
author: DorothyNotInKansas

title: The app I wanted!
body: I have used routine apps in the past and they never entirely fit my needs. This is the first app that offers a practical way to create routines, track time and offers statistics like the average time per task. Love it!
author: AtrumGeost
